description: Apply an effect to clips: a video effect by match name or display name to video clips, an audio effect by display name to audio clips (names from list_available_effects). Appended to the end of the chain, or inserted at position. One undo step

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

effect.description: Video: match name (e.g. "AE.ADBE Gaussian Blur 2") or display name; audio: display name

position.description: Insert at this component index instead of appending

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: apply_effect
title: Apply Effect
